Warn about arguments no method accepts

Source: R/00_typeErrorMessage.R
warn_unused_dots.Rd

The model functions (LCA(), LRA(), Biclustering(), Biclustering_IRM()) take ... only so that S3 dispatch can hand the arguments on to the method for the response type. Once that method has taken what it knows, anything left over is a misspelt or misplaced argument (dataType = for response.type =, max_iter = for maxiter =) that would otherwise vanish without a trace, leaving the default in force. Each terminal method calls this with its remaining dots.

Usage

warn_unused_dots(dots, fun_name, allowed = character())

Arguments

dots

list(...) of the calling method.

fun_name

character. Name of the generic, for the message.

allowed

character. Names that are handled elsewhere (deprecated spellings) and must not be reported.

Value

Invisibly NULL; a warning is issued when something is left.
